desk.headline: Record core EPS of C$1.24, up 6%; net income down 22% on weak investment returns; no outlook update
results: Core earnings rose 4% (constant currency) to a record C$2.1bn and core EPS rose 6% to C$1.24; core return on equity was 17.8%.
Net income fell 22% to C$1.4bn (EPS C$0.82) as private equity, real estate, farmland and listed shares returned less than expected, plus a C$100m net charge in Vietnam.
Asia core earnings grew 17% and the U.S. 5%; Canada rose 3%; wealth and asset management fell 5%, hurt by Hong Kong's switch to the eMPF pension platform.
New business was flat: APE sales C$2.6bn and new business value C$907m, with strong Hong Kong and Japan offset by weaker mainland China.
C$1.3bn went back to shareholders in the quarter; the annual actuarial review was net favourable but cut net income by C$175m after tax.

guidance.summary: The quarterly report gives no new outlook and no change to targets.
